title: Reference-Free, Long-Horizon Trajectory Optimization for Aggressive Autonomous Driving in Milliseconds
summary: Autonomous vehicles must generate long-horizon and dynamically feasible trajectories in real time-even when operating at the limits of vehicle handling-to ensure safe operation in adverse conditions. However, existing work rarely quantifies the computational demands of generating such trajectories without prior references, warm starts and often defaults to low-fidelity models, compromising accuracy and control authority. We investigate the modeling and solver design choices that enable real-time solution of long-horizon, reference-free optimal control problems (OCPs) using full vehicle…
